releaseToOrgName.description: Name of the organization making the request.

releaseToProviderName.description: Name of the provider the patient is being released to.

previousProviders.description: List of previous providers known for the requested patient.

doNotKnowPreviousProvider.description: NOTE: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Please use the `previousProviders` field instead.

reasonForRequest.description: Reason for the request: `0` for Future Appointment or `2` for Information Gathering.

futureAppointmentDate.description: Date of the future appointment in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Required if the request reason is `0 (Future Appointment)`.

requestingProviderEmail.description: Email address of the provider or physician making the request.

patientAuthFile.description: Base-64 encoded file data for the patient authorization file, if available.

referenceId.description: User-defined reference number for the request. This can be used for your own records and is not used by the Predoc platform.

facesheetConfigId.description: Facesheet config ID to generate request with.

facesheetConfigIds.description: Facesheet config IDs to generate request with.

stateCode.description: Two letter state code for the address.

postalCode.description: Postal code for the address - 5 digits.

countryCode.description: NOTE: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

encodedFile.description: Base-64 encoded data of the file being uploaded.

fileExtension.description: File extension of the file being uploaded.

dataType.description: Type of the file being uploaded.

orgName.description: Full name of the organization provider. This is only required when `providerFirstName` and `providerLastName` are not used.

providerFirstName.description: First name of the provider. This is only required when `orgName` is not used.

providerLastName.description: Last name of the provider. This is only required when `orgName` is not used.

orgAddress.description: Physical address of the organization's provider.

orgPhoneCountryCode.description: Country code of the organization's phone number with a + at the beginning.

orgPhoneNumber.description: Phone number of the organization, with no special characters (digits only).

orgFaxNumber.description: Fax number of the organization, with no special characters (digits only).

datesOfService.description: Date range of when the organization provided care to the patient.

specificMedicalRecordRequested.description: Type of custom document requested, if necessary.

serviceStartDate.description: Date of when the organization started providing care to the patient.

serviceEndDate.description: End date of when the organization stopped providing care to the patient.
